newsitem.title: UK: BSB Holdings sells 19.5 mln BSkyB shares.
newsitem.headline: BSB Holdings sells 19.5 mln BSkyB shares.

text.p: British media group Granada Group Plc said on Wednesday that BSB Holdings Ltd has sold 19.5 million shares in British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc.

The sale represents around 1.1 percent of the satellite television company's share capital. BSB, a holding company whose principal asset is its holding in BSkyB, now owns 220.6 million shares in BSkyB, around 12.8 percent.
BSB is 94 percent owned by Granada, Pearson Plc and Pathe-Cinema.

The proceeds of the sale will be used to permit a proposed restructuring of BSB's share and loan capital via a scheme to enable shareholders other than Granada, Pearson and Pathe to realise their holding in BSB.
Granada said that if the plan was successfully implemented then it would, along with Pearson and Pathe, own 100 percent of BSB.
BSB has no plans to sell any further BSkyB shares.
